suites.title: Migration smoke: clean-channel roundtrip
suites.claim: all three public facades recover a clean-channel payload bit-exactly and Lite declares :posterior_anchor_ls
suites.provenance: authored for this package (phase-1 migration gate)

suites.title: Executable provenance pins
suites.claim: the five migrated algorithm files and three LDPC helper binaries match their pinned sha256 digests from the source repository, so a silent fork is impossible
suites.provenance: authored for this package (fork detector vs sonique @ d49fff0)

suites.title: Migrated source layout and facade pruning
suites.claim: src/ carries exactly the Lite closure (common, frame_wide_ldpc, lite) and the wrapper exposes exactly the JunaLite, JunaStandard, and JunaPartialFFT facades while every foreign variant file and facade is absent

suites.title: Receiver selection and init defaults
suites.claim: the migrated runtime modes select distinct modems and init() resets to the benchmark geometry
suites.provenance: adapted: scope narrowed to the three migrated facades

suites.title: Public modulate/demodulate boundary
suites.claim: every migrated receiver crosses the m-sequence, 3x3 fc/fs, waveform-length, metric-polarity, payload-rate, and error contracts; supported boundaries recover clean payloads
suites.provenance: adapted: scope narrowed to the three migrated facades

suites.title: Modem interface and refinement capability contract
suites.claim: the descriptor catalog exactly covers the three migrated public facades; every path satisfies Modulations, executes its declared objective (:none, :pilot_band_ls, :posterior_anchor_ls), and decodes a noiseless loopback payload-exactly
suites.provenance: adapted: scope narrowed to the three migrated facades

suites.title: Payload bits and block sizing
suites.claim: positive payload sizes exclude inner pilots (170 unknown of k=340), reject zero, and count 1280-sample blocks (N=1024 + CP 256)

suites.title: OFDM tone layout and band partition
suites.claim: DC-nulled active tones split into comb pilots and data bands; bw times the fixed 24 kHz reference sets occupied width, fs sets the FFT occupancy fraction, and dc0 tunes the RF centre from 24 kHz without shifting baseband bins

suites.title: JUNA-lite soft-anchor refinement
suites.claim: posterior metrics become confidence-weighted soft data anchors, JUNA-lite refits an invalid seed into a finite valid candidate, and valid seeds are preserved

suites.title: Baseline receivers: standard OFDM and partial FFT
suites.claim: the paper's OFDM+FEC and Partial FFT+FEC benchmark branches are public receiver modes pinned to their demodulate_methods columns, per-band combining survives the within-symbol channel one-tap cannot, lite never loses to its own seed, and both baselines roundtrip BPSK

suites.title: Decoder-feedback mechanism arms
suites.claim: the coupled receivers expose validated :real/:frozen/:genie/:graded feedback arms that share one code path, so frozen anchors no data decision, the oracle arms anchor transmitted symbols at unit weight and fail loudly without them, and graded corruption is seeded, bounded and on-constellation

suites.title: Pilot-conditioned P=1/P=4 JUNA-Lite front end
suites.claim: disjoint outer-pilot folds collapse the Lite seed to full-FFT-equivalent P=1 unless the configured multi-part combiner has a material held-out prediction advantage
